anita: Hitting a reproducible mismatch in the embed/rerank sampleapp. When the SDK retries after auth failure the returned list sometimes reorders and the key name alternates between `embedding` and `vector`. Causing downstream upserts to get wrong vectors.

leo: That sounds like two separate bugs colliding: ordering loss in the batch helper and inconsistent field normalization between SDKs. Which languages?

anita: Node 0.12.2 and Python 0.10.0. Node usually keeps order but Python sometimes returns `vector` and flips items. Minimal repro: request items [x,y,z] -> response order [y,x,z] and keys `vector` for some items.

tasha: Do you have logs for the retry flow? If a single item gets 401 and the client retries the whole batch without an idempotency token we will process duplicates and any map-based merge can scramble order.

anita: Yes: auth failed on idx 1, client retried entire payload; server processed a re-ordered shard. Log shows missing `X-Request-ID` header.

leo: Quick mitigations: 1) make batcher use array positions and include `_seq` per item, 2) SDKs should canonicalize response fields to `embedding`, 3) client should send `X-Request-ID` for the batch and ideally per-item ids.

tasha: Agreed. Also propose server-side guard: reject full-batch retries if `X-Request-ID` missing and return 409 unless client opts-in. That reduces accidental duplicates.

anita: For onboarding unblock I'll patch sampleapp batcher to tag `_seq` and force `embedding` normalization in the response adapter. Small PR incoming.
